entries.name: Inspect Hermes gateway

extra_args.launch_command: echo HERMES_INSPECT_BEGIN; systemctl --user show hermes-gateway.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStatus --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo ENV_KEYSETS; for f in ${HOME}/.hermes/gateway.env ${HOME}/.hermes/.env; do echo FILE:$f; if [ -f "$f" ]; then awk -F= '!/^[[:space:]]*(#|$)/ {print $1}' "$f" | sort -u; else echo MISSING; fi; done; echo CONFIG_ENDPOINTS; if [ -f ${HOME}/.hermes/config.yaml ]; then grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(provider|default|base_url|model|vision|gemma|qwen|endpoint|url):' ${HOME}/.hermes/config.yaml || true; fi; echo JOURNAL; journalctl --user -u hermes-gateway.service -n 100 --no-pager 2>&1 | sed -E 's/([Aa]uthorization|[Tt]oken|[Kk]ey|[Pp]assword)([=: ]+)[^ ,;]+/\1\2[REDACTED]/g'; echo HERMES_INSPECT_END; sleep 45
